title: Listen and Choose a Response — Part-Time Job

questions.stem: I drive past your street, so I can give you a ride tomorrow.

options.A: The street was repaired last month.
options.B: That'd be great. I'll be ready by seven thirty.
options.C: I gave him a ride yesterday.
options.D: I drove past the store yesterday.

questions.explanation: Accepting the offer and giving a time is natural. The others reuse 'drive', 'street', and 'ride' with the wrong tense or pronoun.
questions.speaker: m5
